adjudication.rationale: `parseRefreshTokenResponse` returns the Zod `safeParse` result object (`{ success, data, error }`) rather than the parsed `.data` (see `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, it ends with `return refreshTokenResponse;`). In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the result is assigned to `key` and persisted via `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key } })`, which would store the wrapper object instead of the expected credential shape. This would corrupt the stored credential payload after a refresh. The behavior is not prevented by env flags because the function always returns the wrapper regardless of branch (it only changes which schema is used).
